CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'app_private'
AS $function$
  select exists(
    select 1 from public.profiles p
    where p.id = auth.uid() and p.active and p.role='admin'
  );
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.is_secretary()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'app_private'
AS $function$
  select exists(
    select 1 from public.profiles p
    where p.id = auth.uid() and p.active and p.role='secretary'
  );
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.job_accessible(p_job uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'app_private'
AS $function$
  select
    app_private.is_admin()
    or app_private.is_secretary()
    or exists(
      select 1
      from public.jobs j
      join public.profiles p on p.id = auth.uid()
      where j.id = p_job
        and p.active
        and p.role = 'worker'
        and (
          j.status = 'active'
          or j.created_by = auth.uid()
          or exists(
            select 1
            from public.assignments a
            where a.job_id = j.id
              and a.worker_id = auth.uid()
          )
        )
    );
$function$
